summary: Verified fix for 'notify is not defined' ReferenceError on /admin/projects. Login as admin → page loads cleanly → modal opens via + button → OS 'TEST-FIX-NOTIFY-01' entered → clicked 'Criar e adicionar tarefas' → navigated successfully to /admin/edit-project?id=6a4e613ea77ed8fd78987b8c and new project rendered with correct OS. critical_code_review_comments: notify() helper is duplicated across 3 files (/app/frontend/app/admin/projects.tsx, /app/frontend/app/admin/edit-project.tsx, /app/frontend/app/supervisor/projects.tsx). Consider extracting to a shared util /app/frontend/utils/notify.ts to prevent recurrence of this exact bug and reduce drift.
Two console errors observed (404 and 405) on unrelated resources during page load - not blocking but worth investigating (likely a favicon/manifest or misrouted request).
seed_data_creation: Created test project OS 'TEST-FIX-NOTIFY-01' (id 6a4e613ea77ed8fd78987b8c) and deleted it after test via DELETE /api/projects/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fixed. notify() function in /app/frontend/app/admin/projects.tsx (lines 10-17) correctly resolved. Zero pageerror or 'notify is not defined' console errors captured during full E2E flow (load projects list + open create modal + create project + navigate to editor).
rca of the issue: Root cause: previous search_replace attempt failed to insert the notify() helper at the top of admin/projects.tsx, causing ReferenceError when useEffect -> load() -> catch block invoked notify. Fix (inserting `const notify = (title, message) => Platform.OS==='web' ? window.alert : Alert.alert` at line 10) is verified working. Recommendation: dedupe notify() into a shared util module.
